name: Browser Use
description: Inspect and operate websites directly in the owner’s connected browser, including tabs, forms, collections, and authenticated file downloads. Prefer this toolkit for browser tasks.
progressive_guidance: Use direct browser inspection first for website tasks. Continue in the relevant existing tab and preserve the owner’s chosen browser. Use computer_use for native dialogs or controls that browser inspection cannot expose. Before processing a collection, establish its scope and source identities through pagination or scrolling; a current DOM snapshot does not prove that the full collection has been enumerated. Keep progress and remaining work in the shared task plan.
